tokens.name: layout.primary
tokens.role: Responsive booking grid connected to itinerary detail. Search, itinerary, price, baggage, and disruption states share portable roles.

tokens.name: type.hierarchy
tokens.notes: No owner fonts or exact type values are stored.
tokens.role: Humanist sans type keeps instructions and repeated controls approachable without softening their meaning. Components support web and mobile without erasing platform expectations.

tokens.name: color.role
tokens.notes: The role is analytical; preview colors are original study values.
tokens.role: Currency, language, date, and place variation influence layout and copy.

tokens.name: interaction.priority
tokens.role: Changes, delays, and booking problems expose next action and status.

tokens.name: media.strategy
tokens.notes: Destination media requires its own rights and art direction.
tokens.role: Localized itinerary and fare comparison with a visible disruption recovery state. Icons identify action or state and never carry meaning alone.
